"An Android preview with fictional data. Messages and attachments are stored only on this device and are not sent to anyone.

There is no Odoo connection, real incoming notification service, or calling. A manual local notification test is available. Uninstalling deletes local content.

Installed version: %1$s
%2$s

Every distributed update has a higher version number within the same app to preserve its data."

"• Incremental local storage preserves the prior snapshot during migration; unread state is durable.
• Text, attachments and replies save together, with visible retry guidance when saving fails.
• Bounded history and search windows retain reading, search and cursor state; clearer Reply and swipe-to-reply.
• Image zoom, pan and original detail, with background PDF preview.
• Import completeness and new-import checksums; older files are not retrospectively certified.

Local preview only: no employee authentication, Odoo connection or cross-device messages. Automatic attachment deletion stays disabled. Keep important originals outside this local preview; a prior save may omit newer changes."

There is no automatic download or network connection. Importing preserves the original bytes. Save a copy opens the Android picker so you can choose a destination.

Limits: 25 MiB per file, 100 MiB per draft, and 10 attachments.

Local deletion can be undone, so related files may remain. Uninstalling removes local data; there is no bulk erase here."
